name: Nocturne Sonata
source:
Aino has been all alone, drifting through space for weeks. Everyone else vanished one day,  no trace of them left. Separated from the rest of civilization, she tries to stay optimistic.  Things are mundane until one day,  an unknown object looms eerily close to the ship...

[From [url=https://iceyocey.itch.io/nocturn-sonata]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾诺孤身一人在太空中漂流了数周。有一天，其他人都消失了，没有留下任何痕迹。与其他文明隔绝后，她努力保持乐观。一切都很平常，直到有一天，一个未知物体诡异地出现在船附近……

[来自[url=https://iceyocey.itch.io/nocturn-sonata]itch.io[/url]]
